items.item_text: Experience and knowledge, using two-way radio and proper radio etiquette.

Experience in a call center or similar high call volume type environment or in person in a clear, mature, cooperative, informative, and diplomatic manner with staff, physicians, executives, and general public.
Experience with communicating via telephone and in person in a clear, mature, cooperative, informative, and diplomatic manner with staff, physicians, executives, and general public.
Computer experience and skills to use keyboard to access data, perform basic troubleshooting, and etc.

Responsible for providing directory assistance to incoming callers with the ability to deal with highly confidential information. Responsible for assessing priorities and using telephone soft skills to handle high priority and urgent patient matters. Must have computer experience and be able to use keyboard to access data, basic computer troubleshooting. Responsible for performance of special functions and projects as they are assigned by the supervisor. Has the ability to work varied hours when needed. Displays outstanding interpersonal skills, excellent customer service skills, in all interactions with stakeholders: physicians, staff, vendors, patients, and visitors. #CA-JC
Demonstrated high-level customer service, communication and interpersonal skills.
Typing skills sufficient to use computer keyboard for timely and accurate input and production
Ability to follow oral and written direction and instructions which are presented in a variety of formats.
Ability to pay strict attention to detail.
